dedupe_keys.name: uke siis broadband infrastructure information system yearly archives 2013 to 2020 poland

description: The System Informacyjny o Infrastrukturze Szerokopasmowej (SIIS) was Poland's information system on broadband infrastructure, collecting yearly inventories from telecom undertakings under UKE. Through an API and yearly archives it provided the contact details of undertakings able to serve a location, the address and other identifiers of buildings where services can be provided, the technology of the service, the maximum internet access speed that can be offered to end users, and the telecom and technical infrastructure usable for broadband, such as network nodes and lines. The system has been switched off after changes in the law altered the data structure, the dataset will no longer be updated, and a new system, the Punkt Informacyjny do spraw Telekomunikacji (PIT), is being introduced for telecom infrastructure information. Offline archives remain on dane.gov.pl for 2013, 2014, 2015, 2017, 2018, 2019 and 2020, with API documentation. Coverage: Poland. Format and access: ZIP archives, free under CC0 1.0. Caveats: historical data only, ending with the 2020 inventory; the 2016 archive is not listed; field definitions are in the old API documentation, whose host may no longer answer. Simulation uses: address-level broadband availability and network node locations for exposure analysis and for validating newer coverage data. Related records: the UKE radio permit lists cover wireless sites, and the Ofcom Connected Nations and ANACOM coverage data are comparable national broadband datasets.
name: UKE SIIS broadband infrastructure information system: yearly archives 2013 to 2020 (Poland)
